title: SaaS product website with demo-request motion
summary: A software product site whose job is to prove value fast and convert visitors into booked demos or qualified leads through visual proof, pricing logic, and social evidence.
defaults: Make the demo or contact request the single dominant CTA
Show the product itself, not only abstractions
Anchor credibility with customer evidence and pricing logic
risks: Feature paragraphs without any product visual
No single obvious demo or contact path
verification: Reach the demo or contact form in one obvious step
Review pricing tiers and what changes between them
Find customer or product evidence supporting the claims
site_goals: Book demos and capture qualified leads
Demonstrate product value quickly with visual product proof
Establish credibility with customers, case evidence, and pricing logic

typical_views.name: Landing hero
typical_views.purpose: State the value proposition and route to the demo request immediately

typical_views.name: Product tour
typical_views.purpose: Show the product working with feature highlights and screenshots

typical_views.name: Pricing
typical_views.purpose: Explain tiers and what changes between them to pre-qualify leads

typical_views.name: Customer evidence
typical_views.purpose: Build credibility with case studies, testimonials, and logos

typical_views.name: Demo or contact form
typical_views.purpose: Capture leads with minimal friction and clear expectations

typical_views.name: FAQ
typical_views.purpose: Answer adoption objections that block demo requests

example_startups.note: Segment-picked landing paths and demo forms everywhere
